title: About Travelber & Our Editorial Approach
description: How Travelber creates researched European travel guides, uses real photography and handles commercial links and corrections.
body:
THE THINKING BEHIND THE GUIDES

Travel well.
Know a little more.

An independent English-language guide to short European escapes. Starting small, with the Netherlands.

What we aim to make useful

We help you choose a destination, build a realistic itinerary and understand practical decisions before booking. We favour clear trade-offs over enormous lists. A research-based guide is not presented as a personal trip report.

How these guides are made

Our initial guides are research-led and prepared with AI assistance. Travelber Editorial is the site’s publishing identity, not a named local expert. Official sources are linked where used; itinerary suggestions are editorial recommendations. A check date means cited sources were reviewed, not that every place was visited in person.

Commercial relationships

This release has no affiliate tracking links or paid placements. We may introduce clearly labelled affiliate links after relevant programmes approve participation. Any commission relationship will be explained near the recommendation. Current official information links earn us no commission.

Real photography, credited

No AI-generated destination photographs are used. Images illustrate their stated locations, not a hotel inspection.

  • Amsterdam canal: Martijn Stoof / Pexels
  • Dutch windmill: Freek Wolsink / Pexels

Used under the Pexels licence. Photographers and pictured locations do not endorse Travelber. Typographic illustrations are not photographs.

Corrections & contact

Email admin@travelber.com with the page address, the detail in question and an official source if available. Do not send payment-card information or booking passwords.
